title: Orchestration run status
description: Minimal machine-readable execution state for one unit of work, stored at .orchestration/runs/<WORK-ID>/status.json. Deliberately small: this is durable state, not a workflow database or event log.

work_id.description: Run identifier; matches the directory name.

objective.description: One-sentence objective. Full detail lives in handoff.md.

current_agent.description: Agent that owns the next action, e.g. lead | test | developer | reviewer | null when awaiting a human.

current_state.description: Short factual description of where execution actually is.

attempts.description: One entry per recovery attempt. Bounded by .orchestration/policy/retry-limits.json.

reason.description: Why this retry was permitted and what changed.

failure_signal.description: Observed signal; compared across attempts to detect no-progress.

gate.description: Set when stopped at a human gate; null otherwise.

question.description: Exactly what the human must decide.

escalation.description: What a human is being asked to resolve, when escalated.

evidence_index.description: Paths of evidence records for this run.

examples.objective: Prevent double-booking of the same stylist slot.
examples.current_state: Failing test written and confirmed failing; implementation not started.
examples.next_action: Make the failing booking-conflict test pass without altering the test.
